CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

2. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)

9. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.

10. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
